summary: This continuation plans affine Deligne–Lusztig nonemptiness and dimension, beginning with classical and perfect spherical loci and ending with the shrunken-chamber theorem through cordial reduction. It imports generic root data, Newton invariants and flag geometry from their existing owners. Component theorems, integral specialization and the Kottwitz trace formula form separate proposed continuations. Explicit proof gates preserve the differences between equal characteristic, perfect spherical geometry and the general local-field statement. This is a complete target-level planning pass with all nine stages planned, not a closed or formalized development.
